# Stellar AppKit Demos

> Live, copy-pasteable demos of @saganta/stellar-appkit — 14 working examples of Stellar wallet connection, transaction signing, Soroban contract calls, SIWS authentication, and theming.
>
> URL: https://demos.stellar-appkit.saganta.com
> Library: https://github.com/SagantaHQ/stellar-appkit
> Docs: https://stellar-appkit.saganta.com
> npm: @saganta/stellar-appkit
> License: MIT

## Demos

### Wallet Connection
- [Connect a Wallet](https://demos.stellar-appkit.saganta.com/demos/connect-wallet): The minimal modal-based flow — render the modal, let the user pick a wallet, show the connected address
- [Wallet Picker](https://demos.stellar-appkit.saganta.com/demos/multi-wallet-list): Build your own wallet picker UI with registry.listReachability()
- [Network Mismatch Recovery](https://demos.stellar-appkit.saganta.com/demos/network-mismatch): Typed NetworkMismatchError + auto-retry polling

### Signing & Previews
- [Sign a Transaction](https://demos.stellar-appkit.saganta.com/demos/sign-transaction): Build a payment XDR, sign through the modal's preview flow
- [Sign a Message](https://demos.stellar-appkit.saganta.com/demos/sign-message): Sign an arbitrary message, inspect signedData for SIWS verification
- [Custom Transaction Preview](https://demos.stellar-appkit.saganta.com/demos/custom-preview-ui): Build your own preview UI with usePreviewTransaction()

### Soroban
- [Soroban Contract Invoke](https://demos.stellar-appkit.saganta.com/demos/soroban-invoke): Full invoke() pipeline — build → simulate → preview → sign → submit → poll
- [Typed Contract Client](https://demos.stellar-appkit.saganta.com/demos/typed-contract-client): Type-safe contract calls with soroban.contract<T>()
- [RPC Failover](https://demos.stellar-appkit.saganta.com/demos/soroban-failover): Multi-provider failover with health tracking

### Sign-In With Stellar
- [SIWS Sign-In](https://demos.stellar-appkit.saganta.com/demos/siws-sign-in): Full client + server flow with session cookie — verifySiws() server-side
- [SIWS Session via Middleware](https://demos.stellar-appkit.saganta.com/demos/siws-session-middleware): Protect routes with Next.js middleware
- [SIWS Debug Verification](https://demos.stellar-appkit.saganta.com/demos/siws-debug-verification): Diagnostics dump of every candidate byte sequence

### UI & Theming
- [Theming Showcase](https://demos.stellar-appkit.saganta.com/demos/theming-showcase): Every CSS custom property, live preview with presets
- [Modal Presentation Modes](https://demos.stellar-appkit.saganta.com/demos/modal-modes): Switch between auto / modal / bottomsheet / inline modes + try every WAAPI animation preset (none, fade, scale, scale-blur, slide-up, slide-left, implode)
